== Earlier PC image ==
The image [[:File:DS2-L-lieutenanttelsij-holotable-by-2018-07-08.gif]] says “may subtract 2”. The later 27 January 2022 image says “subtracts 2” and adds a comma after “sector”. The earlier image has no implemented historical GEMP mapping; its article therefore does not display a GEMP ID. The supported current family remains <code>9_23</code>.
